# runzero_credentials (Data Source)

Fetches a list of RunZero credentials.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `credentials` (Attributes List) List of credentials. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Read-Only:

- `acl` (Map of String) Access control list mapping organization UUIDs to permission levels.
- `cidrs` (List of String) List of allowed CIDR ranges.
- `client_id` (String) The client UUID.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the credential was created.
- `created_by_email` (String) Email of the user who created the credential.
- `created_by_id` (String) UUID of the user who created the credential.
- `global` (Boolean) Whether the credential is globally available.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the credential.
- `last_used_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the credential was last used.
- `last_used_by_id` (String) UUID of the user who last used the credential.
- `name` (String) The name of the credential.
- `type` (String) The type of the credential.
